this_week.action: Read Greek OECD questionnaire end-to-end. Mark adaptations for TEKE, IRIS, digital wallets, current Greek banking landscape.
Email external sampling consultant — (a) one-pager by 1 Jun, (b) weights by 15 Aug, (c) join the kickoff call.
Pull 2022 OECD/INFE fieldwork files: missed strata, refusal patterns, mean interview length, refusal-conversion scripts.
Confirm interviewer bench for July — names, dates, vacation conflicts. Written confirmation, not Slack.
Draft 70% of PMQP using proposal as the base. Focus time on architecture diagram + QC flowchart.
IT/Tech: confirm VICIdial capacity, server, encryption status, audit log retention.
Send Ministry pre-read (one page): project parameters, governance, RACI, asks. Sets the frame.
Block Αθανάσιος's August leave to ≤ 5 days. Non-negotiable. Do this now while it's polite.

subtasks.task: PMQP — 80% reuse from proposal. Architecture diagram + QC flowchart are what they read.
Questionnaire adaptation — financial-product naming only (TEKE / IRIS / wallets / Greek credit). DO NOT touch OECD core items.
subtasks.notes: OECD Secretariat will catch core-item changes.

subtasks.task: Submit two questionnaire versions (minimal + fuller adaptation). Ministry picks.
subtasks.notes: Gives them ownership; avoids the 'why did you change this' loop.

subtasks.task: Sampling plan — confirm RDD frame currency (mobile penetration shifted since 2022).
subtasks.notes: Flag landline-share drift internally, not to Ministry unless it matters.

subtasks.task: Defensive scripting on OECD core-item routing — don't wait for pilot to find bugs.
Start recruiting Day 1. 'Training complete 23 Jun' = recruit week 1, induction-brief week 2, formal training week 3.
Two smaller briefings (morning shift + evening shift). Beats one big one for attention quality.
Ministry attends first 30 min of briefing only. Then they leave — don't let them sit through role-play.
Use 2022 wave material as warm-up. Half the bench has done this before.
Per-interviewer sign-off is QA's call, not Field Director's. Independence matters when something goes wrong.
Aim for 150 over 4–5 days (officially 100). Better power; extras feed into final n.
QA monitors live → pilot report writes itself. Don't make it a project.
Pre-decision rule: non-core script changes OK; core-item changes require PM + Data Director sign-off and a methodological deviation note.
subtasks.notes: Most pilot 'issues' are interviewer issues, not script issues.

subtasks.task: Confirm soft-launch into main fieldwork (gives 4–5 extra interviewing days).
Daily KPI dashboard internally. Weekly KPI report to Ministry. Never confuse the two.
Friday report style: tight, factual, forward-looking. Never 'concerned about…' or 'may not make…'
Mid-July: pre-plan a Saturday push and a midweek evening blitz. Vacation peak.
QA verification 12–15% (10% floor). Findings must be unimpeachable.
Front-load calling for small strata (Ionian, Voreio + Notio Aigaio) from Day 1, not from week 2.
Booster decision point: 22 Jul. Any stratum <70% → trigger booster, don't wait until week 3.
Deliver daily sample-completion update: export region × urbanity completes from Survey Solutions and upload to the Sample tracker (every fieldwork day, by 10:00).
subtasks.notes: Use the daily-update template. Cumulative completes per stratum.

subtasks.task: Strict sequencing: cleaning → weighting → OECD template build → QC. No parallel work on dependent tasks.
Sampling consultant delivers weights by 15 Aug. Chase weekly.
Build to OECD template from CATI script outwards. Retrofit at the end loses 5 days.
Internal QC pass before anything goes to Ministry. QA Director signs final file in writing.
Preliminary national report ~25 pages. Not a thesis.
Cross-sectional cuts: age, gender, education, region, income. That's it.
Build the late-Oct Ministry presentation deck WHILE writing the report. Reuse charts.
Lead with 2022 → 2026 comparability story. That's what makes this report useful.

critical_path.why: Ministry + BoG + HCMC each have opinions. Organic review loses 2 weeks. Force a single consolidated review with hard 5-day SLA on Day 1, minuted.
Greek summer + CATI shift schedule = real bottleneck. Losing 5 good interviewers to vacations kills fieldwork. Lock the bench in writing this week.
Filter/routing bugs on OECD core items go straight to Αθανάσιος (most stretched role). Defensive checks in P1; don't wait for pilot to find them.
Ionian, Voreio Aigaio, Notio Aigaio will fall behind. Over-allocate calling load from Day 1, not week 2 when we notice.

risks.mitigation: Submit minimal-adaptation version first; force the SLA at kickoff.

risks.risk: BoG or HCMC adds questions late
risks.mitigation: Establish single-Ministry-voice rule at kickoff; document it.
Retainer + subcontractor backstop locked this week.

risks.risk: Pilot reveals OECD core-item routing bug
risks.mitigation: Defensive scripting in P1; pre-decision rule for post-pilot changes.
Front-load calling there from day 1 of fieldwork.
Protected August leave; backup Data Analyst identified now.

risks.risk: August vacation drift → Sep delivery slips
risks.mitigation: Hard internal date of 28 Aug; staggered leave with PM approval only.

risks.risk: Ministry wants preliminary results before fieldwork ends
risks.mitigation: Hard no; blame OECD/INFE protocol if pushed.

risks.risk: OECD Secretariat changes template format mid-project
risks.mitigation: Watch INFE communications weekly; Αθανάσιος owns this watch.
Weekly check-in; same family but pretend it's arms-length.

buffers.item: The 7–10 day internal buffer per milestone (that's why it's there)
Depth of cross-sectional analysis in the preliminary report (keep it preliminary)
Interviewer over-recruitment (cheaper to release than to scramble)
26 strata represented (even if some are thin)
End-of-October deadline (Ministry needs OECD platform upload — slipping kills 2030 prospects)

kickoff_playbook.item: Single Ministry point of contact for questionnaire decisions.
5-working-day SLA on Ministry reviews of any deliverable we submit.
Written ack that mid-fieldwork questionnaire changes are out of scope.
Verbal ack (minuted) that pilot can soft-launch into main fieldwork — 4–5 extra interviewing days.
BoG and HCMC inputs route through Ministry, not directly to us.
Shadow dates. Ever. Including under polite pressure.
Any concern without a mitigation. No problems-without-solutions on Day 1.
Internal team allocations, subcontractor details. Stay high-level.
Extra analyses, extra cuts, extra languages — all out of scope.
Methodological debates. Refer to OECD/INFE Toolkit 2026.
BoG/HCMC pushing extra questions → smile, defer to Ministry, do not commit.
Anyone asking about preliminary results before fieldwork ends. Hard no.
Vague 'let's discuss as we go' language. Get specificity now or pay later.
